# Security Policy

Please report security vulnerabilities privately, through GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/i2y/connect-lean/security/advisories/new),
and not in public issues.

Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and which versions it affects.
The maintainers aim to respond within a few business days. Once a fix is
released, the report is published as a security advisory.

Security fixes go into the latest release.
